events.title: Supreme Court denies injunction in Tangipa v. Newsom
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States denied the application for a writ of injunction pending appeal in the case of Tangipa, David, et al. v. Newsom, Governor of California, et al. The application was initially presented to Justice Kagan, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the injunction sought by the applicants will not be granted while the appeal is pending.
events.why_relevant: The denial of the injunction affects the immediate legal standing and potential outcomes of the appeal process in this case.
